title: Matching an energy solution to the Airy kernels
source_hypothesis: Strict diffractive CAA patch for a real scalar-principal quadratic system with arbitrary complex lower matrices. Actual u in H1, Pu in L2 with every tested tangential L2H^m order on one fixed collar/tube region. No boundary condition or physical-time hypothesis. Conclusion is local distributional matching, H5/6 decaying coefficient, layer-weighted boundary coefficient and all tangential mixed orders of the residual; full stable coefficient membership remains open.
